for k in range(5):

            toks.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((r0,c0,n['pixels']))
    print(f'click {k+1}: nonHUD={len(nonhud)} toks={toks}')
    if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('game_over'): print('STOP',r.get('stop_reason')); break
